# Lammond Associates

> Specialist supply chain, operations, and procurement recruitment

## About
Lammond Associates is a specialist recruitment firm founded by Tom Birrane, placing senior supply chain, operations, and procurement leaders across the UK. With 20+ years of sector-specific experience, Tom works across Consumer & FMCG, Manufacturing, Pharmaceuticals, and Construction.

## Services
- Permanent Search (contingent model for mid-to-senior hires)
- Retained & Executive Search (director and board-level placements)
- Interim & Contract (IR35-compliant, immediate starts)
- Market Advisory (salary benchmarking, workforce planning)

## Sectors
- Consumer & FMCG
- Manufacturing
- Pharmaceuticals
- Construction
